ai.seo_question: What is recommended to recite in the one hundred rakʿahs on the 21st and 23rd nights?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs performing one hundred rakʿahs on the nights of the 21st and 23rd, with specific recitation in each rakʿah. It highlights the devotional importance of these nights and prescribes a particular form of worship centered on Sūrat al-Fātiḥah and Sūrat al-Ikhlāṣ.
